goal: Repair live Provider component-manifest routing and ownership so canonical multi-file GoalPlan paths receive an interface-capable model and remain assigned to their exact component before leaf generation.
acceptance_criteria: A regression reproduces the YanTu failure shape where a canonical backend owns many GoalPlan paths and verifies the manifest call route.
Initial component-manifest generation selects the configured interface-capable large model independently of small-payload downgrade logic.
Ordinary small component-generation payload routing remains available outside the component-manifest contract.
Exact canonical GoalPlan path ownership outranks generic frontend/backend directory guesses even when a package hint is present.
A high-complexity canonical Python leaf with many public symbols expands into safe same-directory bounded submodules that inherit only the exact parent ownership and retain independent checkpoints.
Provider-mainline, routing, kernel, and management validation pass without adding a generation or delivery path.

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: canonical goal behaviors mapped to substantive executable tests and a real passing post-build test run
quality_metrics.target: every canonical test intent has one exact non-trivial test symbol and the post-build goal-acceptance receipt is PASS before review readiness
quality_metrics.method: deterministic plan-identity inspection, Python test AST inspection, post-build test-result binding, and negative missing/trivial/failed-test cases

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: The Provider manifest route and semantic repair route preserve the configured large-model capability floor.
A current canonical_goal_project_plan assignment is the ownership authority for exact required paths; the generic directory table remains only a fallback for undeclared paths.
Automatic bounded children inherit only a safe same-directory parent-prefixed path, while arbitrary provider child paths remain subject to ordinary ownership rules.

feedback: Accepted with limits: routing, canonical ownership, and bounded submodule relationships passed regressions and live checkpoints; full YanTu delivery remains blocked by Provider balance.

worked: Reading each new live failure as a violated authority or dependency relationship exposed model-floor, path-owner, and leaf-granularity defects in causal order.
did_not_work: Payload size, generic directory guesses, and monolithic public-symbol leaves each overrode the more specific semantic contract.
experiments: After Provider balance is restored, resume the exact src/service.py checkpoint and measure whether the remaining canonical leaves complete without manifest or ownership intervention.
